strings.literal.指定角色同样只隐藏展示模型；适合单独排除兼容性有问题的 NPC。: The specified actor's display model is also hidden; useful for excluding an incompatible NPC.
strings.literal.默认 4。值越高，NPC 背包和条件扫描越分散；玩家刷新与模型物: Default 4. Higher values spread NPC inventory and condition scans; player refresh and model physics are unaffected.
strings.literal.普通候选优先当前装备 (Equipped Candidate P: Prefer Currently Equipped Item (Equipped Candidate Priority)
strings.literal.启用后，普通插槽候选排序会把当前装备物品排在收藏/最近获得之前。: When enabled, standard slot candidates place the currently equipped item before favorited/recently acquired items.
strings.literal.自定义规则的最近展示插槽记忆 (IAD Extension): Recent Display Slot Memory for Custom Rules (IAD Extension)
strings.literal.仅供 Last-Equipped Custom 的展示槽回退使用: Used only for Last-Equipped Custom display-slot fallback; standard slots always follow IED order.
strings.literal.正装备物品保留高优先级插槽 (Equipped Reservat: Reserve High-Priority Slots for Equipped Items (Equipped Reservation)
strings.literal.启用后，priority > 0 的插槽会先尝试接收当前装备物品: When enabled, slots with priority > 0 try the currently equipped item first; priority = 0 is unaffected.
strings.literal.最近获得物品优先 (IED Acquired Priority): Prioritize Recently Acquired Items (IED Acquired Priority)
strings.literal.启用后，普通候选会按最近拾取顺序优先展示；已装备和收藏仍然更优先: When enabled, standard candidates are ordered by recent pickup; equipped and favorited items still take priority.
strings.literal.启用后，节点监控和调试只处理下方列表内的节点名称。: When enabled, node monitoring and debugging process only names in the list below.
strings.literal.关闭后，所有插槽和节点保留基础变换，不再模拟摆动。: When disabled, slots and nodes keep base transforms and no longer simulate sway.
strings.literal.关闭后，所有插槽、专属展示和模型组的效果着色器均不会应用。: When disabled, effect shaders are not applied to slots, custom displays, or model groups.
strings.literal.关闭后，所有插槽、专属展示和模型组均不会添加或保留模型灯光。: When disabled, model lights are not added to or kept on slots, custom displays, or model groups.
strings.literal.条件树中选择 RuntimeVariable，并填入变量名即可引: Select RuntimeVariable in the condition tree and enter the variable name to reference it.
strings.literal.条件树中选择 RuntimeNumberVariable，并使用: Select RuntimeNumberVariable in the condition tree and use comparisons such as >=1 or <5.
strings.literal.模型替换区域可勾选变量源，并选择这里的路径变量或 FormID: In the model replacement section, enable variable sources and select a path or FormID variable here.
strings.literal.状态从 0 开始；每次按下主键会循环到 1..状态数。条件使用: States start at 0; each press of the main key cycles through 1..state count. Use KeyBindState conditions with the binding name and comparisons such as ==1 or >0.
strings.literal.主键/组合键为 Windows 虚拟键码：F1=112，F10=: Main and modifier keys use Windows virtual key codes: F1=112, F10=121, Ctrl=17, Shift=16, Alt=18. A modifier value of 0 requires no modifier.
strings.literal.按顺序评估规则。命中规则后默认停止，勾选继续评估可让后续规则覆盖: Rules are evaluated in order. Evaluation stops after a match by default; enable Continue to let later rules override the result.
strings.literal.变量顺序决定相互引用时的更新顺序；规则顺序决定匹配优先级。: Variable order controls updates for cross-references; rule order controls match priority.
strings.literal.预设文件保存在 Profiles/ConditionalVari: Profiles are stored in Profiles/ConditionalVariables; Apply replaces all variables, while Merge updates or appends by name.
strings.literal.每次轮询读取当前装备的 WEAP；未装备武器时输出 000000: Each poll reads the currently equipped WEAP; outputs 00000000 when no weapon is equipped.
strings.literal.命中时使用当前装备的 WEAP；未装备武器时输出 0000000: On a match, use the currently equipped WEAP; outputs 00000000 when no weapon is equipped.
strings.literal.命中后继续评估后续规则: Continue Evaluating Later Rules After Match
strings.literal.你可以自由组合修饰键和主按键来唤出菜单。: Combine modifier and main keys freely to open the menu.
strings.literal.💡 注意：关闭菜单已被强制锁定为 ESC 键。: 💡 Note: closing the menu is locked to the ESC key.
strings.literal.Vanilla 骨骼是只读预览，不能直接写回 IAD 配置。: Vanilla skeletons are read-only previews and cannot be written back to IAD configuration.
strings.literal.，拖动对应的红/绿/蓝轴可编辑位置。: , drag the red/green/blue axis to edit position.
strings.literal.；当前范围没有本地配置，请先在编辑窗口添加 Override。: ; there is no local configuration in the current scope. Add an Override in the editor first.
strings.literal.；拖动插槽轴时会在当前范围自动创建 Override。: ; dragging a slot axis automatically creates an Override in the current scope.
strings.literal.已为插槽启用 Override Transform，正在编辑当前: Override Transform enabled for the slot; editing the current gender position.
strings.literal.正在编辑本地位置；注意：状态机中的变换可能在匹配时覆盖它。: Editing local position; note that state-machine transforms may override it on match.
strings.literal.当前目标配置已改变，请重新选择场景节点。: The target configuration changed; select the scene node again.
strings.literal.本次节点拖动已完成，可撤销。当前可撤销: This node drag is complete and can be undone. Undo steps available:
strings.literal.已取消当前插槽编辑，自动创建的 Override 已移除。: Current slot edit canceled; the automatic Override was removed.
strings.literal.当前目标配置已不存在，无法恢复当前节点编辑。: The target configuration no longer exists; the current node edit cannot be restored.
strings.literal.当前仍在拖动节点，请先松开鼠标或取消当前拖动。: A node is still being dragged; release the mouse or cancel the current drag first.
strings.literal.已撤销插槽编辑，自动创建的 Override 已移除。: Slot edit undone; the automatic Override was removed.
strings.literal.上次编辑对应的配置已不存在，无法撤销。: The configuration for the last edit no longer exists; it cannot be undone.
strings.literal.角色 3D 场景已替换，已清除旧的可视化节点选择。: The character 3D scene changed; the previous visualization node selection was cleared.
strings.literal.当前自动显示: 根据已选目标决定: Current automatic display: determined by the selected target
strings.literal.左键点击节点或装备轮廓选择；拖动红/绿/蓝轴移动。右键拖动旋转角: Left-click a node or equipment outline to select it; drag the red/green/blue axes to move. Right-drag rotates the character, middle-drag pans, and the wheel zooms. Shift is fine (0.1x), Ctrl is coarse (4x), Ctrl+Shift is very fine (0.025x). Ctrl+Z repeatedly undoes drags.
strings.literal.没有可撤销的编辑（快捷键：Ctrl+Z）: No edit can be undone (hotkey: Ctrl+Z)
strings.literal.首选物品始终优先。选择模式只作用于其余合格候选；无结果时回退到常: Preferred items always win. Selection mode applies only to other eligible candidates; if none are found, normal candidates are used.
strings.literal.【手动布局模式】\n当前插槽只会显示 1 个弹匣。:
[Manual Layout Mode]
This slot displays only one magazine.
strings.literal.留空则不生成枪套。\n例: Weapons/Holsters/M:
Leave empty to generate no holster.
Example: Weapons/Holsters/MyHolster.nif
strings.literal.为这把武器单独指定一个枪套！\n留空则尝试继承插槽配置。:
Specify a separate holster for this weapon!
Leave empty to inherit the slot configuration.
strings.literal.留空时挂到当前 Custom/Slot 的默认 MOV；选择节点: When empty, attach to the current Custom/Slot default MOV; selecting a node creates an independent MOV for this model group.
strings.literal.仅隐藏几何，保留挂载节点 (Hide Geometry)##Cu: Hide Geometry Only, Keep Attachment Node##Custom
